author: ios_user_1
text: I keep a wishlist of shirts and dresses in Myntra, but I do not buy until I see stronger reviews and better customer photos.

author: ios_user_2
text: My saved footwear list is basically a comparison board. I jump between Myntra and AJIO, then I forget which pair I liked most.

author: ios_user_3
text: As a new user I wishlist sneakers first, but sizing doubt keeps me from checking out without extra fit guidance.

author: ios_user_4
text: I save sarees to wishlist until I know the occasion and how to style them, otherwise they just sit there.

author: ios_user_5
text: I save sandals on Myntra but still leave the app to search sizing opinions before I buy from the wishlist.

author: ios_user_6
text: Wishlist works like a temporary shortlist for me, but once there are too many saved products I stop making decisions.

author: ios_user_7
text: I keep saving kurtas for festivals but do not purchase until I know how they will look with the rest of my outfit.

author: ios_user_8
text: The saved list for footwear under ₹2000 is full of options, but comparison across apps keeps delaying checkout.

author: ios_user_9
text: I save tops and jackets on Myntra mainly as bookmarks, then I go to social media for styling reassurance before buying.

author: ios_user_10
text: Without enough review detail, my saved products remain in wishlist for weeks because I am not confident enough to purchase.
